transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... nice to meet you too. I, uh... I guess I'm mostly here because of my wife. She thinks it's all just talk, but... I know what I'm hearing. 

Down at the domino table... the men there, they give these little messages. Just meant for me. Sometimes the fella on the radio does it, too. They're... well, they're warning me to be careful. I didn't really want to come make a fuss about it, but... that's what's going on.
How long have you been hearing these messages?
Well... I suppose it's been a while now. Maybe... about nine months or so. Not every day, just... on and off.
Have you had a period of unusually elevated or irritable mood lasting several days?

Well... I suppose. Sometimes there's weeks where I just wake up feeling... real bright. Like I'm somebody important, I guess. I might talk pretty fast then, maybe laugh a bit louder than usual. 

But... if folks start questioning me, or trying to slow me down... I suppose I can get a little sharp with 'em. I just don't like being pestered, is all.
Have you heard these messages during times when your mood felt normal?

I suppose... yeah. There was a spell, maybe a month or so, where things were just quiet. I was sleeping fine... wasn't getting worked up over any big plans or nothing. Just normal. 

But... well, I still heard my friend out on the porch. And the radio... it was still talking to me, too. So... yes.
Over the past nine months, have your significant mood changes been present for most of that time?

I suppose... yeah. If you look at the whole nine months... most of it's been those high-energy spells. Or... dealing with the aftereffects of 'em. The calmer stretches... well, they just haven't lasted as long.
During the month when your mood felt normal, did you continue hearing those messages for at least two weeks?

I reckon... yeah. Like I said before, it was a quiet month. I was sleeping fine, didn't have no big plans or nothing. But... well, I still heard him out on the porch. And the radio. It kept on like that for... well, at least two weeks out of that month, I suppose.
During one of those high-energy spells, did your mood or behavior cause serious problems in your work, relationships, or daily life?

Well... I suppose it did, a bit. I stopped going to choir practice... and the garden got a bit overgrown. Just didn't have the mind for it. And... well, the fellas at the domino games... I guess I made things a bit tense. So I don't go down there much anymore.
